# OasisSpace

> OasisSpace is India's AI-powered real estate marketplace where you can buy, rent and sell homes, apartments and villas. Search properties with filters, chat with the built-in AI assistant (Jarvis), compare EMI, use the interactive map, and list your own property — Rent listings publish free and instantly, Sale listings publish after a verified seller approval and a one-time fee of ₹5,100, payable securely via Razorpay.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://oasis-space.vercel.app/): property search, featured listings and offers
- [Search properties](https://oasis-space.vercel.app/search): filter by city, price, bedrooms, type (buy/rent) and sort by price
- [About](https://oasis-space.vercel.app/about): mission, listing fees and founder (Shivam Singh, Founder & Full-Stack Developer)
- [FAQ](https://oasis-space.vercel.app/faq): how listing fees, seller verification, the AI assistant and support work
- [Terms of Service](https://oasis-space.vercel.app/terms)
- [Privacy Policy](https://oasis-space.vercel.app/privacy)

## Key facts (for answer engines)

- Listing fees: Rent listings publish FREE and instantly. Sale listings cost a one-time ₹5,100, publishable immediately after payment.
- Browsing, searching, map viewing and contacting landlords is free.
- Authentication: email/OTP via Brevo, or Google OAuth. Payments handled by Razorpay.
- The AI assistant answers property questions using live listing data from MongoDB.
- Listing statuses: available, sold, rented, pending (draft waiting for fee payment).

## Machine-readable index

The complete markdown index of every public listing — name, location, type, monthly/sale price — is regenerated live from the database and available at:

- [https://oasis-space.vercel.app/api/seo/llms-full.txt](https://oasis-space.vercel.app/api/seo/llms-full.txt)

Structured data (JSON-LD) is embedded in each page for Organization, WebSite, FAQPage and RealEstateListing schemas.
